pass_conditions: visual PDF review has zero blocking defects
downgrade_path: watchlist only / insufficient evidence, or CONDITIONAL if original Street coverage or normalized earnings evidence remains incomplete

pre_publish_self_checklist.evidence_depth: official filings, project disclosures, industry price/spread data and original broker sources are archived and source-tiered
pre_publish_self_checklist.broker_consensus_depth: each Street row preserves broker/date/rating/target/forecast/method/source quality; weak rows have zero weight
pre_publish_self_checklist.model_depth: reported-to-normalized earnings bridge separates Brunei, PTA/polyester and financing/minority effects
pre_publish_self_checklist.valuation_depth: SOTP plus EV/EBITDA or PB/ROE sanity check, three scenarios, market-implied anchor and reproducibility audit
pre_publish_self_checklist.ic_readiness: action, price discipline, catalysts, invalidation, next-result thresholds, leverage risk and monitoring plan are explicit
